subject: Mythology
title: The Sphinx: Riddle in Stone
description: A micro-lesson that makes The Sphinx: Riddle in Stone usable.

hook.text: The Great Sphinx has the body of a lion and the face of a pharaoh, and it has guarded Giza for 4,500 years.

buildup.text: It was carved from a single block of limestone, making it the largest monolithic statue in the ancient world.

discovery.text: The Sphinx represented royal power fused with divine strength, a lion's body with a god-king's wisdom.

twist.text: Its nose was deliberately chiseled off centuries ago. Despite legends, Napoleon's soldiers did not do it.

climax.text: The Sphinx was buried in sand for centuries and repeatedly excavated, becoming a symbol of Egypt's mystery.

punchline.text: It has watched empires rise and fall without ever closing its eyes.

quiz.question: What does the Great Sphinx at Giza combine?
options: An eagle's wings and a serpent's tail
A lion's body and a pharaoh's face
A crocodile's body and a falcon's head
